notes.title: Character update
notes.content: [p]Main menu, press new game and create character.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45647972/5f35670f79d7bb1065844debb110b1853e746268.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Here you can choose name, spend stat and skill points.[/p][p]On start player have 5 each stat point and have 5 unspend points. Can remove default points and put 15 to some stat if want.[/p][p]15 skill points to spend, passive effects open on skills every 5 level. Here you can see what would open. Put points and hover mouse to skill name and tooltip will tell.[/p][p]More customization come to right side.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45647972/76a05eb34fb987ad8d997ce9688d317e26b3b25f.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Enhanced equipment panel. If wearing set items, then tooltip on set item will tell set bonuses. It will show more if wearing more set pieces. Here three set pieces equipped.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45647972/bb5c1caed12b3537489422f51a0da49a24b1f336.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Hover mouse to purple cross and tooltip tell bonus stats from items and skills.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45647972/aa7755a1e4211ac9d4931c7a99942471e39adeea.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Here is small part of world map. Player have uncovered some area. Hovering mouse to some places could show tooltip. Tooltip wont show if there is black fog on that area.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45647972/9ac6183bde636b476bb5fb9937b017c7bef9bb8c.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Option to disable or enable fog.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45647972/b066f1d8d61a03d71c14fab2f86f57cdbab74964.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45647972/ac717e463b8948b372878f64f60af9c1a4148e04.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]When completing quest, its possible to change world tiles to other tiles or move npc to somewhere.[/p][p]World will feel more alive.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]
